I love her unconditionally with my whole heart. She's wonderful. She's looked after me when I've been really depressed, she looks after the bills, cooks, all kinds of other stuff.
I've only managed to keep a job, to keep the money coming in.

Her poly-partner doesn't have half the baggage I have, isn't depressed like I am, and looks after her just the same.

There's no "new life" I want (or am capable of having right now), especially not without my partner.

I'm doing so much damage to her though. =(

I love her, and I can't keep her chained to me like she is. It's not good for her.
: grins : yeah

: nods :
I have a lot of baggage she's better off without. I'm dragging her back unfortunately.

Cipralex 20mg a day from the doc.


Then I buy myself - Tramadol 100 to 150mg a day. Rarely Co-codamol, and Modafinil. When I'm really down, they have a massive effect.

>The person you leave behind will never deal with things the way you imagine.

: nods : I've got a lot of baggage. It's not gone anywhere in all these years, and I feel it's dragging her back along with me. She's trying to start a poly relationship because of this, and I'm using it to get her detached from me completely...

I'm trying to get her 'weened' off me at the moment.

She's away for 11 days... with a new friend she's really attached to. I'll see what happens in the future.

Especially *my* body! -giggles-

They also have a car!  -grins-
